caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional rectangular tin container with a metal handle on the top. The surface of the container is predominantly a light brown, wood-like color with painted decorations. One visible side of the tin features two large, round orange-yellow fruits at the lower section, a red flower with green leaves and stem above them, and additional green foliage. The adjacent side displays a pattern resembling flags; at the top is a red and white striped flag with a blue section containing small shapes, and below it is a smaller flag with a black cross and red, white, and yellow areas. The letters "S.T." appear in bold black text beneath the flags. The handle and the top of the tin are shaded with darker tones, suggesting a metallic texture. The entire composition is set against a plain, cream-colored background. The artist’s signature, "H. Lanigan G. Brown," is located on the bottom right of the drawing.
title: Toleware Canteen
